title: Margin Formula
slide_intent: Tie spacing to format size so compositions can retain comparable breathing room across different dimensions.
strategic_value: A single proportional formula can give Burger King layouts consistent edges without separate arbitrary margins for every size.
demonstration: The oversized equation Longest Side / 25 = Margin runs across a red page.
practical_value: Calculate a starting margin from the application’s longest dimension.

content_islands.name: Formula label
content_islands.spec: Place the small heading at upper left.

content_islands.name: Equation
content_islands.spec: Set the cream formula across the center, stacking Longest Side at its left.

ingredient.name: Proportional margin
ingredient.role: Maintain comparable edge spacing across formats.
ingredient.application: Divide the longest side of the application by 25 to obtain the margin.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Page 83 permits manual optical adjustment for very wide or tall formats.

reference_purposes.Application: The equation defines margin as longest side divided by 25.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The formula fixes the divisor at 25; page 83 supplies the extreme-format optical exception.
